description_en: Queries the list of execution plans
name: ListActionPlans

parameters.help_en: The IDs of the execution plans to be queried
parameters.help_zh: 待查询的执行计划 ID列表
parameters.name: action_plan_ids

parameters.help_en:
The maximum number of entries per page.

Valid values: 1 to 100.

Default value: 20
parameters.help_zh:
每页的最大数据条数。

取值范围：1~100。

默认值：20
parameters.name: max_results

ActionPlans.description_en: The list of execution plan results

items.description_en: The information about the prefetch plans

ActionPlanId.description_en: The ID of the execution plan

ActionPlanName.description_en: The name of the execution plan

CreateTime.description_en: The time when the execution plan was created

Status.description_en:
The status of the execution plan. The possible values are as follows:

Active Instant tasks are dynamically managed only when the execution plan is in the Active state.
Inactive Instant tasks are no longer managed by execution plans in the Inactive state.
Deleting: The execution plan is being deleted. You cannot modify the parameters of an execution plan in this state
Status.description_zh:
执行计划状态，可能值如下：

Active：生效状态。处于生效状态的执行计划才会动态管理Instant任务。

Inactive：失效状态。失效状态的执行计划不再管理Instant任务。

Deleting：执行计划正在删除中。该状态下执行计划不支持修改参数

UpdateTime.description_en: The time when the execution plan was last modified. The time follows the ISO 8601 standard and UTC +0. The format is yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ
UpdateTime.description_zh: 执行计划的上次修改时间。以ISO 8601为标准，并使用UTC+0时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH：mmZ

MaxResults.description_en: The maximum number of records returned in this request
MaxResults.description_zh: MaxResults本次请求所返回的最大记录条数
